title: The Five Senses
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting, and touching!

video.title: Your Body's Senses | SciShow Kids Compilation

steps: You have FIVE senses that tell you about the world around you.
Eyes SEE 👀, ears HEAR 👂, nose SMELLS 👃, tongue TASTES 👅, and skin TOUCHES ✋.
Your senses send messages to your brain, and your brain figures out what they mean.
Senses keep you safe too — like smelling smoke or hearing a car horn!

questions.prompt: How many senses do you have?
questions.hint: Count them: see, hear, smell, taste, touch.

questions.prompt: Which body part do you use to SMELL?
Which sense do you use to enjoy music?
Match the helper: your tongue helps you...
